basis: Illustrative allocation of the 40 inferred 737 MAX entries to cash purchases: 20 in September and 20 in December. Assume $40M each, $4M per aircraft already deposited, $2M more in August, 75% borrowing against delivery settlement, 6% annual interest, 1% financing fee and $100M monthly residual capex. Counts align with H2 MAX guidance; months, prices and financing are assumptions. Other purchases and capex are unallocated and must be covered by residual capex; this is not a United forecast.
